recommendation: Keep this source fix. Do not restore workflow-pattern onBehalfOf without a new work-group decision and evidence that the Organization-on-behalf-of use case is common enough for core; use PractitionerRole under the current pattern in the meantime.
issue_request: FHIR-15128 was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to restore Request.requester.onBehalfOf and Event.performer.onBehalfOf after workflow patterns replaced the Practitioner-plus-Organization onBehalfOf pattern with PractitionerRole. The final decision did not restore onBehalfOf for RelatedPerson/other actors under the 80% rule, accepted PractitionerRole as the intended representation, and directed removal of the stale Request constraint that referenced onBehalfOf.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly naming FHIR-15128 was found. Git history shows the old Request.requester.agent/onBehalfOf backbone and its onBehalfOf constraint were introduced before the issue, then workflow reconciliation changed Request.requester and Event.performer to direct references including PractitionerRole. Commit 14b69a1c6dd33918b20d53ffd6cfbab523f840ba removed the stale Request.requester onBehalfOf invariant, matching the Jira resolution, but the Request requester search row still pointed at the removed Request.requester.agent subpath.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request and event as active logical models, so source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml and source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml are current build inputs. Current Request.requester is a direct Reference including PractitionerRole, Organization, Patient, RelatedPerson, and Device, and current Event.performer.actor is a direct Reference including PractitionerRole and RelatedPerson. A January 2018 Zulip thread records that the updated workflow patterns called for eliminating onBehalfOf in favor of PractitionerRole; direct FHIR-15128 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Changed source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml so the requester search-parameter mapping uses Request.requester instead of the removed Request.requester.agent path. No Event source change was needed because Event.performer.onBehalfOf is absent and Event.performer.actor already follows the current direct-reference pattern.
source_changes: source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml: changed the Request pattern requester search-parameter row from Request.requester.agent to Request.requester.

related_jiras.note: The January 2018 Zulip discussion referenced the CareTeam PractitionerRole/onBehalfOf debate, but that issue concerns the CareTeam resource rather than the Request/Event workflow patterns and was not decided here.
